about_the_game:
Broomstick Exorcist is a supernatural Beat 'em up game set in a hand-drawn 2.5D manga-esque monochromatic world. In it, you fight various ghosts and demons inspired by Asian urban myths, immersing you in a world that feels like it's ripped straight from the pages of a black-and-white manga.

About the Combat Demo

This contains a bite-sized combat demo that will serve as a core foundation for the future release. Some highlighted features are:

  • 1 Level exclusive non-story mission with unique enemies and bosses.

  • Unlockable abilities from the start.

  • Take the Broomstick Exorcist with you on the go, as this combat demo is playable on Steam Deck.

While this is still a work-in-progress game, we are very open to any suggestions and feedback. Let us know your thoughts, and please drop by our community hub. We hope you enjoy the demo and appreciate the support!

Story Premise

Somewhere in a corner of this world, spirits refuse to stay dead. Play as Vikka, an insomniac street sweeper who hunts demons at night with her trusty broomstick and supernatural skills. Upgrade your skills, chain your precise combos, and adapt to every battle. And when the battle peaks, Henshin! Embrace your Qareen and transform into the ultimate exorcist!

Key Features

  • Manga-Esque Visual Style

Hand-drawn 2D sprites match the striking contrasts and depth of monochrome manga, setting the tone for a world caught between the mundane and the supernatural.

  • Supernaturally Quirky Foes

From long-heads to the flying mistress and even little restless souls, each enemy you face is uniquely designed with charm and eerie humor, blending folklore and absurdity into every encounter.

  • Broomstick Techniques & Upgrades

Unlock upgradeable skill trees with passive boosts and flashy combo attacks. Customize Vikka’s fighting style and exorcist techniques to match your playstyle.

  • Transform: Unleash Your Other Self

Channel Vikka’s Qareen, a powerful spiritual double born of her other self and Henshin! Become stronger, faster, and fierce enough to turn the tide.
